images.alt: A foggy field, with a clear sky above. A thin red and white mast with support lines is in the right of the image, and a yellow plane is in the left. Arrows indicate the depth of the shallow fog compared to the blue sky above it. The title reads "7:24am, Masterton Airport".

post.text: Visibility at Masterton Airport is currently around 300 metres. A shallow bank of fog formed as the sun rose, and should clear out once it gets a little warmer.

source.agency_name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand (MetService NZ)
